rationale: The plan matches the reference on the core design: batch enters the model as a fixed covariate (~ batch + condition) with control explicitly releveled as reference and a named contrast, counts are never pre-adjusted (ComBat-seq correctly avoided), and normalization is median-of-ratios inside DESeq2 with TMM in the edgeR QL cross-check. QC is dataset-specific and precedes the model (blind VST PCA colored by condition and batch, distance heatmap, library sizes with a >2x-median flag, explicit verification of 3+3 batch balance), though the outlier policy is only 'flag' without a stated action. Filtering (>=10 counts in >=6 samples, justified by smallest group size), BH at alpha 0.05 set in results(), apeglm shrinkage, p-value histogram and Cook's-NA handling are all correct and stated. Enrichment was not asked for and is arguably scope creep across three collections, but it is well specified (Wald stat ranking, tested-gene universe, 15-500 size window, named collections with versions, ORA fallback rule) and assumes human annotation without stating species; the report step is comprehensive on methods, versions, thresholds, counts and caveats.
